inventory.producer: overwriteStep (wizard/steps/02-overwrite.ts) — owns the continue/refuse decision for an existing target; commitTo (temp.ts) is the consumer that fails ENOTEMPTY
inputs: existing target dir with a file (non-vault)
classes: existing non-empty non-vault, interactive (refuse before confirm)
existing target is a regular file (refuse cleanly, exit 1 naming target; shares rule "target must be absent or an empty dir" with non-empty dir)
interactions: step 2 decision x step 4 rename: no continue followed by exit 1
non-empty x vault: vault check precedes non-empty refusal (exit 2 preserved)
parser rejection x step 4 guard for drafts that bypass the parser
